answer: Real work leaves a trail no Sybil farm can fake cheaply. Every paid job ends with the client signing a receipt: job hash, fee, date, and a pigment code, a color tag of the hash, so copies show the same color. Rewards unlock after 20 receipts from 5 different clients. Each epoch, the Raven audit desk picks receipts and sends each client a whisper, one short message asking only: did this job happen, yes or no? A failed callback freezes rewards for 30 days; three flags remove the identity. Faking 100 identities needs 2,000 fake jobs at $5 each: $10,000 burned.
